plan.headline: 24 entries, $130,230 in IEEPA duties paid: two entries ($9,210) have deadlines today, Oct 24, 2026, so start there.

steps.title: Today: file in CAPE for HP7-0414106-2
steps.detail: This entry appears eligible for CAPE (CBP's IEEPA refund portal) for $6,780, but the deadline is today, Oct 24, 2026. Call your broker right away to file it.

steps.title: Today: file a protest for KT4-2208260-1
steps.detail: This entry ($2,430) was liquidated (finalized by CBP) too long ago for CAPE, but it is still inside the 180-day protest window, which closes today, Oct 24, 2026. A protest is a formal written challenge to CBP, and your broker can file it.

steps.title: File in CAPE for HP7-0414533-5
steps.detail: This entry appears eligible for CAPE for $13,230, and it is your largest CAPE item with a near deadline. File by Nov 16, 2026.

steps.title: Withdraw the protest on KT4-2209566-1, then file in CAPE
steps.detail: CAPE rejects entries with an open protest, so the protest must be withdrawn first. Then the entry ($4,260) can go into CAPE. Aim to finish by Nov 20, 2026.

steps.title: File a protest for HP7-0413540-6
steps.detail: CAPE will reject this entry ($3,640), so the protest route is the way to go. The window closes Nov 22, 2026.

steps.title: Fix HP7-0414879-0, then file in CAPE
steps.detail: A goods value is reported on a Chapter 99 line, and CAPE rejects the entry until the value is moved to the Chapter 1-97 line. Ask your broker to correct it so the entry ($4,460) can be filed by Nov 30, 2026.

steps.title: File in CAPE for KT4-2209470-0
steps.detail: This entry appears eligible for CAPE for $2,190. File by Dec 10, 2026.

steps.title: File a protest for HP7-0413822-4
steps.detail: This is your largest protest item at $15,840. CAPE will reject it, so a protest must be filed by Dec 12, 2026.

steps.title: File in CAPE for HP7-0415250-8
steps.detail: This entry appears eligible for CAPE for $3,880. File by Dec 21, 2026.

steps.title: File a protest for HP7-0414117-9
steps.detail: CAPE will reject this entry ($3,750), but the protest window is open until Jan 31, 2027. Don't wait that long, since the earlier items are more urgent.

steps.title: Also file in CAPE (no deadline given)
steps.detail: These entries appear eligible, so ask your broker to include them with your other CAPE filings. KT4-2209003-5 ($8,820) falls under CAPE Phase 2, which has been open since Jun 29, 2026. HP7-0415702-7 is $7,740 and KT4-2210384-7 is $1,960.

steps.title: Get paperwork for HP7-0416475-1 before filing
steps.detail: This $3,180 entry appears only in a broker statement, so the IEEPA amount can't be checked. Ask your broker for the entry summary (Form 7501), then file it in CAPE.

steps.title: Ask your broker about entries CAPE doesn't cover
steps.detail: KT4-2210027-4 ($11,660) is a type CAPE doesn't take today, such as AD/CVD (extra duties on certain unfairly priced imports) or warehouse entries. HP7-0416018-4 ($3,975) had its duties paid by a surety (the bond company), and KT4-2209318-2 ($3,500) is tied to a drawback claim. Ask how CBP is treating each one.

steps.title: Leave the open protest alone
steps.detail: KT4-2208011-9 ($8,070) already has a protest open, so it stays on the protest route and CAPE would reject it. Ask your broker for its status.

steps.title: Wait on the court for finally liquidated entries
steps.detail: These five entries ($20,865 total) are finally liquidated with no protest. A court has certified a class of importers who haven't sued, but there is no refund order yet. For a large balance, consider asking a customs attorney about filing your own suit.

plan.broker_email_subject: URGENT: IEEPA refund filings for North Trail Cycles. Two deadlines today (Oct 24, 2026)
plan.broker_email_body:
Hi,

I'm reviewing our IEEPA tariff refund options for North Trail Cycles Inc. Two entries have deadlines today, Oct 24, 2026:

- HP7-0414106-2 ($6,780): appears eligible for CAPE. Please file today.
- KT4-2208260-1 ($2,430): too late for CAPE, but inside the 180-day protest window. Please file a protest today.

Next, these are due soon:
- HP7-0414533-5 ($13,230): CAPE, by Nov 16, 2026.
- KT4-2209566-1 ($4,260): withdraw our IEEPA-only protest, then file in CAPE, by Nov 20, 2026.
- HP7-0413540-6 ($3,640): protest, by Nov 22, 2026.
- HP7-0414879-0 ($4,460): the goods value is on a Chapter 99 line. Please correct it to the Chapter 1-97 line, then file in CAPE, by Nov 30, 2026.
- KT4-2209470-0 ($2,190): CAPE, by Dec 10, 2026.
- HP7-0413822-4 ($15,840): protest, by Dec 12, 2026.
- HP7-0415250-8 ($3,880): CAPE, by Dec 21, 2026.
- HP7-0414117-9 ($3,750): protest, by Jan 31, 2027.

These also appear eligible for CAPE, with no deadline listed: KT4-2209003-5 ($8,820, Phase 2), HP7-0415702-7 ($7,740) and KT4-2210384-7 ($1,960).

I also need your help with the following:
1. HP7-0416475-1 ($3,180): please send the entry summary (7501) so we can confirm the IEEPA amount before filing in CAPE.
2. KT4-2210027-4 ($11,660), HP7-0416018-4 ($3,975, surety paid) and KT4-2209318-2 ($3,500, drawback): how is CBP treating these, and is there any refund route?
3. KT4-2208011-9 ($8,070): what is the status of the open protest?
4. KT4-2207145-6, HP7-0412207-3, KT4-2207698-3, HP7-0412988-1 and KT4-2208274-8 are finally liquidated. Do you recommend we talk to a customs attorney about our own suit?

Please confirm which of these you can file and when.

Thank you,
North Trail Cycles Inc.

checker.summary: I checked all 24 extracted entries against the 7501s, the Lotus duty statement and the North Trail activity report. All 24 entry numbers are in the extraction. These documents mention more than one importer of record (41-7730284-00, 84-2917365-00). Upload one importer's paperwork at a time. No CAPE file was made and court-plaintiff status was ignored.

No document in this part gives a liquidation status or date for KT4-2209566-1, so the status is 'unknown'. Other parts may give it.

None of the flags (surety paid, protest, drawback, reconciliation, AD/CVD) are mentioned on this page, so all are false. Nothing on this page says whether the importer is a plaintiff at the Court of International Trade, so cit_plaintiff is false and the case and submission date are null.

No broker statement on this page gives an IEEPA amount, so ieepa_duty_statement is null. The Chapter 99 rows (9903.88.03, 9903.01.24 and 9903.01.25) are copied as printed. The page does not say which of them are IEEPA duties.
Line 001 duties add up to the printed total of 7,810.00 (3,550.00 + 2,840.00 + 1,420.00).

Part 6 of 6: the only document here is the Keystone Trade Services broker letter and account activity report (2 pages). There are no 7501 pages in this part, so no HTS lines were available. 'lines' is empty for all 11 entries. If 7501s for these entries appear in other parts, they should be merged in.
Each entry number is on the line before its 'ACE status' line, so the liquidation evidence joins the two lines with ' | '.
KT4-2210027-4 is a type 21 warehouse entry ('Warehouse entry; withdrawals ongoing.'). There's no flag for warehouse status, so all flags were left false for this entry.
KT4-2209003-5 is 'Flagged for reconciliation; no type 09 filed yet.' reconciliation_flag was set to true.
The broker letter says no CAPE declarations have been filed yet for any of these entries. No document in this part mentions surety payment or AD/CVD for any entry.
The 'Duty deposited' totals were not recorded as structured fields. They appear only inside the ieepa_statement evidence quotes.
